title: Register 'rocket new' command in Commander
description: Add the 'new' subcommand to the Commander program. Wire it to the handler in src/commands/new.ts. The command accepts an optional project name argument and has a description explaining its purpose.
acceptanceCriteria: Command description is 'Scaffold a new project from a template'
Command is wired to src/commands/new.ts handler
rocket new --help prints command description and [project-name] argument

steps.description: Import the new command handler in src/cli.ts
steps.details: Add import at top of src/cli.ts: `import { newCommand } from './commands/new.js'`. Create a stub src/commands/new.ts if it doesn't exist yet.
In src/cli.ts, after program setup: `program.command('new [project-name]').description('Scaffold a new project from a template').action(newCommand)`

Create src/commands/new.ts exporting: `export async function newCommand(projectName: string | undefined): Promise<void> { console.log('new command', projectName) }`. This is a stub — full implementation in later tasks.
Run `npm run dev -- new --help`. Should print 'Scaffold a new project from a template' and show [project-name] as an argument.

technicalNotes: Commander's action() callback receives arguments in the order they are defined in the command string
[project-name] is optional (square brackets) vs <project-name> which is required (angle brackets)
